style.backgroundSystem: deep navy-blue tiled wall #3A4A5E and deep-blue banner #3D4D6E alternating with clean white #FFFFFF and light grey #E8EAED section bases; light grey marble ledge #D8D8D8 as product stage; warm wood-grain door only for installed-on-door scenes
style.iconSystem: consistent thin-line white icons inside rounded squares on deep-blue panels
style.lightingSystem: soft directional studio light from upper left with a gentle highlight sweep across metal surfaces, soft contact shadows, cool 5500K on scene shots, controlled cyan accent glow only on sensor shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium smart-home ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy-blue tile backdrop #3A4A5E, deep-blue banner #3D4D6E, clean white section base #FFFFFF, soft mist-grey card base #E8EAED, and one cyan-tech accent #37C8E8; cool neutral lighting; modern geometric sans-serif headlines and labels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line white icons in rounded squares; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: slim vertical lock panels upright and centered, stable hero angle across the set, product never floating and always grounded with a soft contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: light grey marble ledge, matte brushed dark metal panels, warm wood-grain door leaf
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short Chinese headlines and sublines wrapped in 「」 only, one headline plus short subline per screen
